name: codex-product-experience-agent
description: A Codex-native product experience audit agent for repeatable UX journeys, evidence collection, and repair loops.

scripts.example:codenext:deep: node src/cli.mjs audit --config examples/codenext --journeys deep --url http://127.0.0.1:3599 --user ${CODEX_UX_USER:-admin} --pass ${CODEX_UX_PASS:-} --out artifacts/ux-audit-deep
scripts.example:codenext:core: node src/cli.mjs audit --config examples/codenext --journeys core --url http://127.0.0.1:3599 --user ${CODEX_UX_USER:-admin} --pass ${CODEX_UX_PASS:-} --out artifacts/ux-audit-core
scripts.example:codenext:review: node src/cli.mjs review --config examples/codenext --review product --url http://127.0.0.1:3599 --user ${CODEX_UX_USER:-admin} --pass ${CODEX_UX_PASS:-} --out artifacts/product-experience-review
